response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and systems work, including some genuinely high-scale low-latency experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on growth engineering and experimentation platforms, and the resume shows no evidence of experimentation systems, A/B testing frameworks, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis work — the core domain of the job. There is also little demonstrated multi-workstream, cross-org technical leadership at the principal level, making the fit weak despite solid general engineering credentials.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across languages and stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, D, C/C++, Java)
High-scale distributed systems exposure (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, workshops, and mentoring
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience mentioned anywhere
No evidence of principal-level scope: leading multi-team initiatives, platform architecture used across orgs, or stakeholder alignment at enterprise scale
Limited demonstrated data/statistics aptitude (metrics, guardrails, bias detection, experimental analysis)

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and scale experience
